title: Vermont Statutes Annotated, Title 8 (Banking and Insurance), Chapter 129 - Insurance Trade Practices
verified_how: fetched https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/chapter/08/129 (HTTP 200): headings 'Title 8 : Banking and Insurance' and 'Chapter 129 : Insurance Trade Practices', listing s 4721 (Purpose), 4722 (Definitions), 4723 (Unfair methods of competition or unfair or deceptive acts or practices prohibited), 4724 (same, defined), 4725 (Favored agent or insurer; coercion of debtors), 4726 (Power of Commissioner; enforcement) and 4727 (Personal insurance; use of credit information), none marked repealed; the Title 8 index gives 'Chapter 129 : Insurance Trade Practices - Contains: ss 4721 - 4729'. Every page of the Vermont Statutes Online carries the currency line 'The Statutes below include the actions of the 2025 session of the General Assembly.' and the caveat 'NOTE: The Vermont Statutes Online is an unofficial copy of the Vermont Statutes Annotated that is provided as a convenience.' No repeal marker appears on the cited provisions; repealed sections elsewhere in the same chapters are explicitly flagged 'Repealed. <act cite>', so the absence of that marker is meaningful.
notes: Unfair claim settlement practices are defined within s 4724; detailed claim-handling standards are Department of Financial Regulation regulation rather than statute. Policy-content requirements sit in 8 V.S.A. ch. 135 (Insurance Policies).
